rows.en: Hey, this is bad! At this rate, we'll be disqualified when time runs out!
This is bad... At this rate, we'll run out of time and get disqualified.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll be disqualified when time runs out.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll be disqualified when time runs out.
This isn't good... At this rate, we'll be disqualified when time runs out.
This is bad... At this rate, we'll be disqualified when time runs out.
Just then, the door behind them suddenly slammed shut!
Something appeared on a monitor mounted on the wall.
Indeed! I'm Grand Gundam, Lion King of Conquest, one of the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings!
You lot have stood out a little too much. It's time you disappeared.
Hey! What's going on!? We're in here too, you know!
That's right! Let us out of here! Let us go to the Tower!!
Too bad, it's already too late. You can all drop into hell together!
...Damn that Grand Gundam! He's started shelling us!!
You're going to leave us to die!!
What the hell are we supposed to do...!! At this rate, we're next...!!
I'll take you on mys... Gwaaaaaaah!!
Damn it!! Isn't there any way out of here!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we gotta bust outta here!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Anyway, we need to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we have to get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, let's get out of here...!!
Whatever it takes, we gotta get outta here...!!
God Gundam stood before the ice wall, let out a long breath and steadied his breathing.
School of the Undefeated of the East... Final Technique!!
God Gundam brought down the ice wall!

notes.note: #0.14-0.19 are slots 8-13 of the leader block begun at #0.7 (story_079). 0441.bla Pt_Chara_Check index order 6,7,9,10,1,2,3,4,5,11,12,14,15 = Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero. So #0.14 W (Shotaro), #0.15 OOO, #0.16 Ultraman, #0.17 Seven, #0.18 Mebius (polite), #0.19 Zero. Voices confirm (#0.13 Momotaros rough, #0.18 polite). #0.16/17/19 share Japanese with #0.7, #0.9-0.12 in story_079; English should match there.
Sound effect of the door slamming, rendered in double quotes per style.
God Gundam's disbelief (quoting particle); 'They've locked us in' restores the agent, which the next rows reveal as Grand Gundam.
??? = Grand Gundam on the wall monitor before being named.

Grand Gundam's epithet (lion king + contest for supremacy) rendered 'the Lion King of Conquest'; no established English found. Four Heavenly Kings per glossary. Clauses reordered (name first) to fit 2 lines; full meaning kept.
Speaker #276 is unnamed in the glossary; Alien Iros calls it 'Alien Cool' at #0.37 right after it dies, so #276 = Alien Cool (Ultraseven alien). Name not in glossary.
'Together' = the trapped aliens and MS together with the heroes.
Reproach aimed at Grand Gundam (abandoning his own allies). Kept as an exclamation like the source.
Tieren is cut off mid-word by the shelling; English cut likewise.

#0.44-0.69 are escape-line/grunt pairs for 13 leaders in the 0441 order (Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros #0.56, W, OOO #0.60, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius #0.66, Zero #0.68). Identical Japanese, identical English; grunts get '!' as cut-off cries.
#0.71-0.83 leader variants (same order); OOO #0.79 and Mebius #0.82 add the honorific, dropped per style, so all identical.
Ryuha Tohofuhai rendered 'School of the Undefeated of the East' (G Gundam English dub); Sekiha Tenkyoken kept romanized as in the dub. Neither is in the glossary.
Extractor labels this God Gundam, but the script plays it before any CharaNameIn after the cutscene: it is narration.
#0.91-0.103 leader variants (order Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, ...). #0.92 is labelled Zero by the extractor but is the Zeta slot; the line is identical anyway.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader order from 0441.bla Pt_Chara_Check (Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero), confirmed by voice. #0.90 is narration (extractor says God Gundam); #0.92 mislabelled Zero. Not in glossary: Alien Cool (#276), 'Lion King of Conquest' (Grand Gundam epithet), School of the Undefeated of the East, Sekiha Tenkyoken.
